name: ListPage
purpose: Browsing page with a header, optional filters, search, a list/grid view switch and a content area.

parts.name: page
parts.description: Full-height column with 24px gap and 24px padding on the page background.

parts.name: header
parts.description: Uses the PageHeader definition (title, description, breadcrumbs, actions).

parts.name: filters
parts.description: Uses the FilterSidebar definition (orange by default); present only when filter groups exist.

parts.name: toolbar
parts.description: Row with 12px gap: SearchField (orange focus ring, placeholder 'Search...' by default) filling the width, then a ViewToggle (orange, default mode list).

parts.name: content
parts.description: Fills remaining space; supplied by the consumer.

variants.name: view mode
variants.description: Reported to the consumer, which decides how to render content.

layout: Below the header: a row with filters at the left (224px) and the main column (toolbar over content) taking the rest; 24px gap between them.
responsive: The filter sidebar is hidden below 768px and shown from 768px up; the main column then spans the full width.
constraints: The search field here overrides SearchField's default purple with orange.
accessibility: One level-one heading; search labelled; view toggle named 'View mode'.

name: DetailsPage
purpose: Page for a single record: header with status badge, optional body, titled field sections and a side panel.

parts.name: page
parts.description: Full-height column with 24px gap and 24px padding on the page background.

parts.name: header
parts.description: Uses the PageHeader definition. The status badge appears beside the actions at the right of the header.

parts.name: badge
parts.description: Pill, 10px horizontal and 2px vertical padding, 12px medium text; light accent fill with accent text; default color blue; red is also allowed.

parts.name: body panel
parts.description: Panel with card fill, 1px border, extra-large radius, 24px padding, for free content.

parts.name: section
parts.description: Same panel style. Optional 16px medium title, then a definition list in two columns from 640px up (24px column and 16px row gap); each entry has a 12px uppercase muted-foreground term and a 14px foreground value.

parts.name: side panel
parts.description: Fixed 288px column with 16px gap, supplied by the consumer.

layout: Main column (body panel then sections, 24px apart) at left taking the remaining width; side panel at right with 24px gap.
responsive: Side panel hidden below 768px; field grid is a single column below 640px.
constraints: The badge appears in the header actions area, not inside the title.
accessibility: Fields use a description list; side panel is a complementary landmark.

name: DashboardPage
purpose: Overview page: header, a row of metric cards, and one or two content panels.

parts.name: page
parts.description: Full-height column with 24px gap and 24px padding on the page background.

parts.name: stats
parts.description: Grid of StatCard definitions with 16px gaps.

parts.name: primary panel
parts.description: Flexible-width panel: card fill, 1px border, extra-large radius, 24px padding.

parts.name: secondary panel
parts.description: Fixed 320px wide panel with the same styling.

layout: Stats grid, then a row with the primary panel and (to its right, 24px gap) the secondary panel.
responsive: Stats grid is 1 column below 640px, 2 columns from 640px, 4 columns from 1024px. The secondary panel is hidden below 768px.
constraints: Each stat card keeps its own default color (blue) unless specified.
accessibility: One level-one heading; panels need their own headings supplied by the consumer.
